propositions: Comment triage cannot achieve size recovery on two pressure files (_store/event_append.py and reducer/_processors.py) whose comments encode load-bearing replay-compat and snapshot-restore rationale

Five verified-stale comments across four files contain false/outdated module paths, key enumerations, and temporal references that must be corrected against live runtime behavior or deleted when their referents no longer exist

The wire-format changelog exists in two homes with partial/stale duplication (reducer/_version.py prose and docs/event-schema.md); the canonical documentation must be completed before the code copy is collapsed to a citation

The highest-risk do_not_move unit (reducer/_processors.py:719-774) contains four snapshot-restore migration guards whose rationale must remain verbatim to prevent live guards from appearing dead, especially one guard that explicitly prevents unconditional execution

A .joe-janitor/tools.md section must be created recording all KEEP/DO_NOT_MOVE comment units and their justifications before any edit lands, with minimum observable verification of the snapshot-restore guards entry
